$note: Thresholds and exemptions for format-changed.mjs and smells.mjs.
$formatExcludeNote: Prefixes format-changed skips: tools/bundle.mjs cannot parse split export lists.
$allowedNumbersNote: Numeric literals that never count as magic numbers.
$minDuplicateTokensNote: Shortest normalized token run, statement-aligned, reported as duplicated.
$maxFunctionLinesNote: Longest function, in source lines from its first to its last line.
$maxNestingNote: Deepest block nesting (if, loop, switch, try) inside one function.
$minRepeatedStringsNote: Times one string literal must appear in function bodies of a file to count as repeated.
